Class JsonbMetadata

java.lang.Object
iu.client.jsonb.JsonbMetadata
All Implemented Interfaces:
BindingMetadata
public final class JsonbMetadata extends Object implements BindingMetadata
Reads JSON-B annotations; the only class the IU binding paths reach that refers to the JSON-B API, loaded only when the API is present.

A type or property the IU binding paths convert that declares a JSON-B component, by @JsonbTypeAdapter, @JsonbTypeSerializer, or @JsonbTypeDeserializer, converts through a provider created on first use, with no configuration but the IU conversion's options, so the component sees a JSON-B context.
